description: Writes a text file listing every plugin and module used in the open patch, for crediting the makers
notes: nothing happens until you press the round button near the bottom and choose a file to save to. That button is not a parameter, so clicking it for help gives nothing.
the file lists each plugin's brand and name and, under it, the modules from that plugin in the patch, sorted and listed once each. A file name with no extension gets .txt added.
the module has no jacks at all; it reads the patch itself rather than anything patched into it.
menu: Include plugin URLs — adds each plugin's web address after its name
Only include plugin names — leaves the module names out, so the file lists only the plugins
ALL CAPS — writes the brand and module names in capitals
